overview: This enum selects which screen or game mode a posed character capture is prepared for.

None.technical: None is the default for CharacterCapture rows, capture slots, and sequencer capture actors. WidgetManager_ToWidgetCaptureMask has no matching branch, so it contributes no widget capture bit. ApplyTemporalAASamples also leaves the Temporal AA setting unchanged.

CharacterSelect.technical: CharacterSelect selects the normal character-select portrait. Game code passes it to AGameCharacterCaptureActor::RequestCharacter. FindCharacterCaptureRow walks the character capture set and returns the first row whose CaptureType matches. ToWidgetCaptureMask maps it to its widget capture bit, and ApplyTemporalAASamples sets the one-sample Temporal AA mode.

StoryCharacterSelect.technical: StoryCharacterSelect selects the story character-select portrait. Game code passes it to AGameCharacterCaptureActor::RequestCharacter. FindCharacterCaptureRow walks the character capture set and returns the first row whose CaptureType matches. ToWidgetCaptureMask maps it to its widget capture bit, and ApplyTemporalAASamples sets the one-sample Temporal AA mode.

VsAlly.simple: Use the ally portrait for the battle situation overview.
VsAlly.technical: GameBattleSituationOverviewWidget requests one slot per ally with this type. FindCharacterCaptureRow matches rows by CaptureType, and SituationOverview paths read the ally animation, shikigami, and weapon arrays. ToWidgetCaptureMask adds the VsAlly bit, and ApplyTemporalAASamples sets eight Temporal AA samples.

VsEnemy.simple: Use the enemy portrait for the battle situation overview.
VsEnemy.technical: GameBattleSituationOverviewWidget requests one slot per enemy and places those slots after the VsAlly group. SituationOverview paths read the enemy animation, shikigami, and weapon arrays. GetCharacterParameters separates these slots from other capture slots. ToWidgetCaptureMask adds the VsEnemy bit, and ApplyTemporalAASamples sets eight Temporal AA samples.

FreeBattle.technical: FreeBattle selects the free-battle team-select portrait. Game code passes it to AGameCharacterCaptureActor::RequestCharacter. FindCharacterCaptureRow walks the character capture set and returns the first row whose CaptureType matches. ToWidgetCaptureMask maps it to its widget capture bit, and ApplyTemporalAASamples sets the one-sample Temporal AA mode.

PvEEquipment.technical: PvEEquipment is declared as the PvE equipment capture context. ApplyTemporalAASamples has an explicit case that executes the eight-sample Temporal AA command. No traced RequestCharacter caller or exported CharacterCapture row uses it.

PvEGrowth.technical: PvEGrowth is declared as the PvE growth capture context. ApplyTemporalAASamples has an explicit case that executes the eight-sample Temporal AA command. No traced RequestCharacter caller or exported CharacterCapture row uses it.

Customize.technical: GameCustomizeCharaModelWidget requests this type with the zoom and rotation parameters from the model viewer. Customize slots use common transform scale for the character and shikigami and take the variation material pattern on SituationOverview paths. ToWidgetCaptureMask adds the Customize bit, and ApplyTemporalAASamples sets eight Temporal AA samples.

Archive.technical: Archive is declared as the archive capture context. ApplyTemporalAASamples has an explicit case that executes the eight-sample Temporal AA command. No traced RequestCharacter caller or exported CharacterCapture row uses it.

FreeBattleImage.technical: FreeBattleImage is declared as the free-battle image capture context. ApplyTemporalAASamples has an explicit case that executes the eight-sample Temporal AA command. No traced RequestCharacter caller or exported CharacterCapture row uses it.

CP_270_TagCombo.technical: ToWidgetCaptureMask maps this type to EGameWidgetCaptureType::CP_270_TagCombo. GetCaptureSlotCount counts one slot when that bit is set. ApplyTemporalAASamples has no explicit case, and no traced RequestCharacter caller uses this type.

Max.simple: A sentinel after the real capture contexts.
Max.technical: Max is declared immediately after CP_270_TagCombo. No traced consumer, capture request, or exported CharacterCapture row uses it, so its runtime role is unresolved.

Invalid.technical: UGameCharacterCaptureWidget initializes its CaptureType member to Invalid. WidgetManager_ToWidgetCaptureMask has no matching branch and therefore returns no bit for it, while ApplyTemporalAASamples leaves the Temporal AA setting unchanged. No capture request uses this value.

notes: FindCharacterCaptureRow resolves a capture context after walking the character capture set. A missing character, set, row, or type match ends the request without a Capture row.
VsAlly, VsEnemy, and Customize are the SituationOverview contexts. They take poses from SituationOverviewPose rows and use ally data only for VsAlly.

The exported CharacterCapture rows use CharacterSelect, StoryCharacterSelect, VsAlly, VsEnemy, FreeBattle, and Customize. The remaining named contexts are declared in code but are not represented in that export.
